result.summary: Applies upstream Cap'n Proto backport patches to the depends build to fix non-atomic reads in debug assertions. This prevents ThreadSanitizer (TSan) from reporting false-positive data races on mutex futex words and atomic reference counts when objects communicate across threads.
result.problem: In unoptimized builds such as TSan jobs, Cap'n Proto enables internal debug assertions that inspect mutex futex words and atomic refcounts non-atomically. When cross-thread communication occurs, TSan flags these debug reads as data races and fails test runs.
evidence: PR description links to an active TSan job failure on bitcoin-core/libmultiprocess#376 triggered by cross-thread kj::Executor::executeSync() usage.
Fixes are direct backports of upstream Cap'n Proto commits (capnproto/capnproto#2781, capnproto/capnproto#2843, capnproto/capnproto#2855).
result.scope_notes: Adds upstream patch files to depends for the capnp package.
result.card: Applies upstream Cap'n Proto patches to depends to fix non-atomic reads inside debug assertions. Unoptimized builds enable these assertions, causing ThreadSanitizer to flag data races on mutex words and atomic refcounts during cross-thread communication. This unblocks libmultiprocess#376, whose TSan CI failed due to these assertions when switching event loops to executeSync. The changes are backports of upstream Cap'n Proto commits b91a6ba7c7 and cc13c8c45f.
uncertainties: The patch diff is not available in the prompt, though the commits and PR description clearly describe backporting upstream capnp patches.

risk.why: Flaws in third-party Cap'n Proto depends patches could cause build failures or concurrency bugs in multiprocess builds.
